Reads the README as text and compiles the entry points as files to compare their exports with it; it imports nothing from src at run time, so it covers no published code and judges no mutant. Stryker's Jest config also leaves it out.

Holds the lists of fields the send reader copies to the fields of the types they name by assigning `true` to a type-level test, so the file fails to compile when a field is unlisted. It imports only types from src/, so no code of src runs under it, no mutant is covered by it, and it judges no mutant; the lists themselves are exercised by the specs of the send reader, which the mutation run does execute.

Bundles realm-root.ts with esbuild and runs the bundle in a child process, one real runtime per case, and imports nothing under src/ itself. No mutant is active in a child process, so it can judge none; the mutants of that file are judged by realm-root.spec.ts in the test worker. `pnpm test` and `pnpm test:cov` still run it.
